---
title: Risk-set robustness fixes
date: 2026-11-11
---

## Scope

Apply implementation-only fixes to the annual risk-set builder: tolerate empty station
categories, make joins explicit and checked, remove the obsolete household argument, and replace
logical abbreviations. This change does not settle the treatment-package or age-reference design.

## Decisions retained

- A control is not assigned a fictitious parent station. Its nearest-station distance remains a
  descriptive support variable.
- A future implementation must apply one cohort-level eligibility reference date to every status.
  The current package needs an explicit decision because annual branches can contain more than one
  trial-service date; the project's primary specification remains age 22--60 on the package's
  trial-service date.
- The 2--4 km spillover handling is paused until 2026-11-16. The current classifications must not
  be presented as resolving interference or as a spillover-robust control definition.

## Verification

Run air format and parse the edited R source. Do not rebuild restricted-data targets for these
interface-only changes; the subsequent audit implementation must exercise a representative branch.
